scope: Final replay-exclusive writer, queue, camera buffering, telestrator point, and map-transfer helpers

applied.name: ReplayWriter_SubmitEncodedRecord
applied.evidence: Submits a channel record to each active writer/encoder side subject to writer states and the live-capture routing flag.

applied.name: TelestratorPoint_DecodeFixed16
applied.evidence: Decodes two unsigned 16-bit coordinates into 16.16 fixed-point values.

applied.name: ReplayVoiceQueue_PopAndCloneFront
applied.evidence: Clones and removes the first VoiceStreamData queue item.

applied.name: ReplayTelestratorQueue_PopAndCloneFront
applied.evidence: Clones and removes the first TelestratorStreamData queue item.

applied.name: ReplayMetadataQueue_PopAndCloneFront
applied.evidence: Clones and removes the first MetaStreamData queue item.

applied.name: ReplayGameCommandQueue_PopAndCloneFront
applied.evidence: Clones and removes the first GameCommandStreamData queue item.

applied.name: ReplayMapTransfer_PumpNetwork
applied.evidence: Pumps the active map-transfer service and incoming network packets while playback waits for embedded map resources.

applied.name: ReplayCameraQueue_PopReadyBuffered
applied.evidence: Returns and removes the next buffered camera stream only after the configured frame-delay condition is satisfied.

applied.name: ReplayMapTransfer_StartCustomMapDownload
applied.evidence: Builds and submits the identified custom_maps transfer request.

applied.name: ReplayEncoder_RestartWriterJob
applied.evidence: After a writer job reaches terminal state, releases it and starts the next buffered writer job or records failure.

applied.name: ReplayOutputDescriptor_CopyFrom
applied.evidence: Performs a field-aware copy of the replay output descriptor including its owned strings.

applied.name: ReplayCameraQueue_PeekReadyBuffered
applied.evidence: Peeks the next buffered camera stream when both queues are populated and the configured frame delay has elapsed.

applied.name: ReplayEncoderContext_Ctor
applied.evidence: Initializes job state, retry timing, owned output/header objects, and writer state for one encoder context.

applied.name: ReplayChannelSchedule_InsertBefore
applied.evidence: Thin typed insertion boundary for a scheduled-channel list record.
